info.title: YotaWarp API
info.description: Generates a real Cloudflare WARP WireGuard configuration (optionally with AmneziaWG DPI-bypass parameters) on every call. Knowledge source: the generator page https://yota-warp-self.vercel.app/ (its inline script builds GET /api/generate?dns&mtu&allowed_ips&keepalive&amnezia) plus 3 live GET probes on 2026-10-23 (all parameters, no parameters, and an invalid mtu). Every parameter is optional; omitted ones default to the values below. The server does NO validation: mtu=abc was written into the config verbatim with HTTP 200. Each call returns a new private key and a different WARP IPv6 address (it appears to register a new WARP device), so responses are never identical. Unverified: the failure response shape (success=false with an 'error' string, per the page script) was never observed.

get.description: Returns a newly generated Cloudflare WARP WireGuard / AmneziaWG configuration (new key pair per call).

parameters.name: dns
parameters.description: Comma-separated DNS servers written to the Interface DNS line. Default '1.1.1.1, 1.0.0.1, 2606:4700:4700::1111, 2606:4700:4700::1001'.

parameters.name: mtu
parameters.description: Interface MTU, copied into the config without validation. Default 1280.

parameters.name: amnezia
parameters.description: 'true' adds AmneziaWG obfuscation parameters (DPI bypass); default 'false' (plain WireGuard).

WarpConfig.description: A freshly generated Cloudflare WARP client configuration.

success.description: true on success. The site's own client reads an 'error' string when this is false; no failure was observed.

config.description: Complete WireGuard (or AmneziaWG when amnezia=true) .conf text: [Interface] with a freshly generated PrivateKey, Address, DNS, MTU (plus AmneziaWG obfuscation keys S1/S2/Jc/Jmin/Jmax/H1-H4/I1 when amnezia=true) and [Peer] with PublicKey, AllowedIPs, Endpoint and PersistentKeepalive. Includes a Russian-language comment header.

vpnKey.description: AmneziaVPN import key: 'vpn://' followed by a base64 payload. Present with amnezia=true and amnezia=false.

endpoint.description: Cloudflare WARP registration endpoint, e.g. 'engage.cloudflareclient.com:2408'. The config's own Peer Endpoint can differ.

ipv4.description: Interface IPv4 address assigned by WARP, e.g. '172.16.0.2'.

ipv6.description: Interface IPv6 address assigned by WARP.

amnezia.description: Whether AmneziaWG obfuscation parameters were added.
